scope: Startup verification by edition; warnings and failures describe ScummVM or ScummWEB limitations, excluding problems specific to supplied game files. Not full-game compatibility.

upstreamReference.scope: Upstream ratings do not establish ScummWEB compatibility. Some engines are not included in ScummWEB.

notes: Each checked edition has its own entry. Platform and edition variants are listed separately.
Road and the ScummC edition of Open Quest are fan games that launch under the Day of the Tentacle target. Passport to Adventure is a demo compilation.

The untested list includes Excellent, Good, and Bugged upstream ratings for game IDs without a checked edition. Ports and remakes with separate game IDs retain separate results, as do sequels, annual releases, and episodic parts. The upstream chart groups some supported games instead of listing each title individually.
